description: MainActivity.kt is the main source file for an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It defines the MainActivity class, sets up the app's UI with multiple composables like Dashboard, WorkoutsScreen, StepsScreen, GoalsScreen, and HistoryScreen, and manages state related to workouts, goals, and step count, including sensor integration for step tracking.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main application activity that sets up the UI content.

classes.name: FitTab
classes.description: Enum class representing the tabs in the app navigation with labels and icons.

classes.name: WorkoutEntry
classes.description: Data class representing a workout session with title, duration, calories, and date.

classes.name: GoalEntry
classes.description: Data class representing user goals with type, target, and current progress.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method in MainActivity that initializes the activity and sets the Compose UI.

methods.name: FitBuddyApp
methods.description: Top-level composable setting up the app theme and initial surface.

methods.name: Dashboard
methods.description: Main composable that manages the different sections, tabs, and their state.

methods.name: WorkoutsScreen
methods.description: Displays recent workouts or a placeholder if none exist.

methods.name: StepsScreen
methods.description: Handles step count sensor and displays today's steps along with a weekly chart.

methods.name: BigNumber
methods.description: Displays large numeric value for steps.

methods.name: generateWeekData
methods.description: Generates sample weekly step data incorporating today's steps.

methods.name: StepsBarChart
methods.description: Visualizes weekly step data as a bar chart.

methods.name: GoalCard
methods.description: Displays individual goal with progress bar.

methods.name: HistoryScreen
methods.description: Shows history of workouts or a placeholder if none.
